title: Tách văn bản lớn có tính tất định
apply: chunk-apply creates local chunk files and chunk_manifest.json only
do not write Drive/NLM in chunk-apply
link chunks to canonical in metadata
later ingest selected chunks through normal pipeline if needed
verify: boundaries do not split legal units badly
stop_conditions: more than 3-4 chunks needed in one query without splitting question
rules: For profile documents split by natural structure
VBQPPL chunks are helper sources for NLM only, not legal canonical

idempotency_contract.resume_behavior: reuse chunk_manifest if source_hash unchanged; rerun chunk-apply with --expected-hash to detect drift
idempotency_contract.rollback_hint: delete local chunks; for ingested profile chunks rollback per profile-ingest child
